answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a new unsupervised contrastive learning framework for automatically evaluating the summary qualities without comparing with reference summaries...

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following metrics as our baselines. ROUGE, METEOR, BERTScore, WMS, SMS, S+WMS, MoverScore, BERT+Cos+Ref, BERT+Cos+Doc, LS Score...

answer_4.quote: Each document-summary pair is evaluated by three human raters in four dimensions (coherence, fluency, informativeness, and relevance).
answer_4.guideline: Human raters scored each generated summary on coherence, fluency, informativeness, and relevance.
